_doc: The full island (08/11/2026, Sergio: 'morro no meio, praia em volta, uma ilha pequena, preservando a vila e todas as construções, o restante é vegetação e árvores'; docs/ue58/ILHA_PLANO.md). tools/ue58/gen_island.py reads the survey of the existing land (mare_island.land: first blocking surface on a 5 m grid; land = above the water level 'water_z') and grows new land only where nothing exists yet (the void past the walls of the summit range and around the headlands; the bay's sea floor stays sea). Margin from an existing edge = base + per_height x height of that edge, capped at max, wobbled by noise (amplitude cm, size cm), then the new coast is smoothed (smooth cm); no new land within sea_clear cm of the existing sea floor, so the bay stays open. Outputs: island_sdf.bin + 'sdf' below (signed distance to the coast in cm, negative on land, positive at sea; row-major float16, rows along y from origin) for C++ (UMareIsland::ShoreDistance) and SourceArt/Island/T_IslandSDF.png (16-bit, the same field clamped to +-range for the sea material). All in world cm. bay_waterline_y: where the bay's water meets the sand along the old straight beach; MareIsland::BayEquivalentY maps a coast distance D to the old y = bay_waterline_y - D, so formulas written along y follow the coast all round.
